description: Get active solicitations (RFPs, RFQs, IFBs) whose due date and time, in New York, has not yet passed. Sorted by due date ascending — soonest deadlines first. BetaNYC labels notices in betanyc_notes (no closing time, placeholder date, extension, correction, cancellation) and folds older amended notices into the newest; matched cancellation notices go under cancelled, the solicitation stays listed.

include_superseded.description: List every notice, folded ones included, each labeled (default false)

limit.description: Max results (default 25; more than 100 is lowered to 100)

offset.description: Notices to skip, for the next page (default 0)

name: get_open_solicitations
